summary: Verdict tractable_large, with two findings that change the plan. FIRST, machine-verified in scratch/HvalidShapeRefutation.lean (lake env lean clean, zero sorries): DP-3 and DP-4 are unprovable AS STATED, independently of all persistence work. tableau_complete's hvalid premise quantifies over arbitrary edges and arbitrary b with no tableau provenance, while IValid only covers upward-closed valuations; at edges=[(1,0)], b=[T(p)@0,T(q)@1], phi=p->(q->p) the theorem proves IValid phi yet refutes hvalid's body, so the sorry cannot be filled and a signature change to openBranch_countermodel/tableau_complete is mandatory (the theorem itself is not refuted, only the proof route). SECOND, a NEW refutation risk Gate B never considered: independent beta-split choices at the reused ancestor x versus the blocked world w (both carry the same disjunction, each split expanded separately) appear to break atom-level persistence across the recorded loop-back edge, and the reuse check is never re-run to invalidate that edge; if realizable this forces permanent deferral, so a Gate B2 probe must run BEFORE any build-out. THIRD, a genuine de-risking discovery: the reuse check at Expansion.lean:296-307 already enforces exactly the needed backward containment (posFormulasAt bPers w subset of posFormulasAt bPers x, since sfor IS {phi} union posFormulasAt bPers w), so the gap is purely temporal (post-reuse arrivals), and IWorldHist's par/(H0)/(H1)/(H1-acc) supply Gate B's assumed ForestComparable for free. Edge direction confirmed from source: edges are (child,parent), the reuse arm appends (x,l) with l=newEdge.2=w giving w<=x while raw x<=w, so x and w become preorder-equivalent and must AGREE on atoms.

weaker_sufficient_statement: Yes — full per-formula origin tracing may be avoidable. Because the reuse check already gives posFormulasAt bPers w subset of posFormulasAt bPers x, and bPers is applyPersistenceFixpoint b edges f (so w has already received every raw-ancestor copy by Phase 4's copy-completeness), the residual obligation is only: no positive formula arrives at w after the reuse event without also being at x. Post-reuse arrivals have exactly two sources, each with a candidate cheap discharge. (a) Decomposition at w of a premise present at reuse time: that premise is at x by the containment, and the final branch is saturated (IBranchSaturation is already exported), so the same decomposition is available at x. (b) A copy from a raw ancestor y of w: par-linearity makes y and x comparable, and if y <= x the V4 copy channel delivers to x as well. UNVERIFIED, and the residual x <= y <= w case is where this could still collapse into full origin tracing — but it is materially cheaper to attempt first than re-building IWorldHist.
decomposition: 0. GATE B2 (GATING, run first): probe the beta-split refutation shape.
